description: Convert text to speech. Use a Kokoro voice (af_heart, am_adam, ...), a saved trainer voice as 'trainer:<name>', or a one-off clone as 'clone:/path/to/ref.wav'.
name: speak

text.description: The text to convert to speech

voice.description: Kokoro voice (af_heart, af_sky, am_adam), 'trainer:<name>' for a saved trainer voice, or 'clone:/path/to/ref.wav'

description: Speak text in a voice cloned from a reference clip (one-off, not persisted). For a recurring trainer voice, use register_voice then speak with voice='trainer:<name>'.
name: clone_voice

reference_audio.description: The uploaded reference clip (file id, filename, or path). Leave empty to use the most recently uploaded audio.

text.description: Text to speak with the cloned voice

description: Register a persisted trainer-voice profile so future training sessions can be narrated in that voice. Register once, then speak with voice='trainer:<name>'.
name: register_voice

name.description: Short profile name (lowercase letters, digits, _ or -)

reference_audio.description: The trainer's uploaded reference clip (file id, filename, or path). Leave empty to use the most recently uploaded audio. 10-15s of clean speech works best.

reference_text.description: Exact transcript of the reference clip (improves fidelity)

description: List available voices, including built-in voices and registered trainer-voice profiles.
name: list_voices
